key_findings.finding: The strongest exact database match is esterification of the benzoic acid to methyl 2-bromo-5-chlorobenzoate, product SMILES COC(=O)c1cc(Cl)ccc1Br. The record includes all five listed components and gives this product.

Most plausible reaction class is oxalyl-chloride/DMF-mediated carboxylic-acid activation followed by methanol trapping: oxalyl chloride converts the acid to the acid chloride in situ, DMF catalytically promotes activation, dichloromethane is the solvent, and methanol provides the methyl ester. Without methanol, the same reagent set is also documented to stop at 2-bromo-5-chlorobenzoyl chloride.
